response.content:
RECEIVED MAY 01 '89
G. R. DiMarco to Many twee Place frumo.
TO: Dr. G.R. Di Marco
FROM: W.D. Dahne
DATE: 26 April 1989
REF: SELECTIVE FILTER ADDITIVE
I attach a copy of a notice which we have received from our Hong Kong office, which may be important enough to follow up. It is claimed that scientists in Moscow have developed a filter additive which supposedly absorbs 100% of the nitric oxide from the cigarette smoke. Unfortunately no reference is given as to where the information was received, and it may be necessary to contact Esmerk directly.
Kind regards.
Wolfang W. D & Dahne
cc: F.H. Christopher
50706 6741
